phase82.description: Electrically-Rewritable Silicon Validation — A→B write-cycle proof for 8 chips

op_values.write_A+verify_A: Write image A (seed=1, full-size deterministic pseudo-random) and read-back verify; SHA-256 must match gen_test_image.py output
op_values.write_B+verify_B: Write image B (seed=2) WITHOUT an explicit erase; if auto-erase fired, B SHA-256 matches cleanly; any residual A-bits break B verify (SHA mismatch → RC=1)

verdict_taxonomy.PASS: dev write-cycle exits 0, B SHA-256 matches B source image, no residual A-bits detected
verdict_taxonomy.FAIL (CR-01): W29C020 mid-page-poll write failure — pre-attributed: flash4_page_size(262144)→128B (heuristic under-sizes), real datasheet page=256B; RCA/fix deferred to Phase 84 FIX-01
verdict_taxonomy.FAIL (genuine): N=2 reseat+retry exhausted, non-CR-01 root cause
verdict_taxonomy.ANOMALY: Flaky result (intermittent SHA mismatch), reseat/retry not deterministic

phase82.image_generator: tools/gen_test_image.py — generate_image(size_bytes, seed) → bytes using random.Random(seed); CLI: python tools/gen_test_image.py <size_bytes> <seed> <output_path> prints SHA-256

cells.anomalies: Auto-erase proven (clean B over A, no explicit erase); consistency-check N=3 1-distinct-SHA; neg-control verify(A) RC=1. Initial attempt hit VPP-high 13.1V>12.0V (Phase-81 VPP-regulator family) — operator corrected VPP, clean retry. DB-01: DIP28_27512/EEPROM/12V/65536 confirmed vs silicon.

FAIL (genuine): erase cannot clear bit 7 @0x3d (reads 0x7f, want 0xFF) — DETERMINISTIC across initial run + 2 reseats (D-08 N=2 exhausted), identical offset/value every time = stuck cell, not contact/VPP. First session: write-cycle A RC=0 then write-cycle B erase failed + read jittered 14/65536 bytes (0xEF↔0xFF); both retries failed at erase-A. Chip read clean in Phase 81 (read-only) — defect manifests only on erase/write. DB-01 DIP28_27512/EEPROM/12V/65536 confirmed (write path engaged correctly; genuine silicon wear, not DB/algo mismatch). neg-control verify(A) RC=1. REWR-01 partial.

Auto-erase proven (clean B over A, no explicit erase); consistency-check N=3 1-distinct-SHA == image B; neg-control verify(A) RC=1. No VPP hiccup. DB-01: DIP28_27512/EEPROM/12V/65536 confirmed vs silicon.

FAIL (genuine): erase cannot clear bit 4 @0x7db (reads 0xef, want 0xFF) — DETERMINISTIC across initial run + 1 reseat (same offset/value), genuine stuck cell. Same stuck-bit-on-erase signature class as W27E512 (different offset). Chip read clean in Phase 81 (read-only); defect manifests only on erase/write. DB-01 DIP32_STD/EEPROM/12V/524288 confirmed (write path engaged at correct params; genuine silicon wear, not DB/algo). REWR-02 partial.

Auto-erase proven (clean B over A, no explicit erase); flash3 slow path ~240s/write; consistency-check N=3 1-distinct-SHA == image B; neg-control verify(A) RC=1. DB-01: pinout DIP32_SST39SF040 / 12V / 524288 confirmed vs silicon. DB-01 NOTE for Phase 84: DB electrical.type reads 'Flash/EEPROM' while milestone classes this as 0x06 flash3/Flash — observation, not a blocker; no inline DB edit.

Overwrite proof, no erase (D-06): clean B read-back SHA == image B confirms B fully replaced A. Used DIRECT write path (write -b) — 'dev write-cycle' unusable on FRAM (erase 'Not supported'; same Phase-81 erase/blank-check tooling gap, flag Phase 84 FIX-01, NOT fixed here). write A/verify A RC=0, write B/verify B RC=0, consistency-check N=3 1-distinct-SHA == image B, neg-control verify(A) RC=1. DB-01: pinout DIP28_JEDEC_SRAM_8K / 8192 confirmed vs silicon; NOTE for Phase 84 — DB electrical.type 'SRAM' vs FRAM family (observation, no inline DB edit).
